sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — accessing a property through a chain of optionals silently returns nil if any link is absent, collapsing the entire expression to nothing.
sketches.resonance: A chain of trust that only works if every single person shows up; one absence undoes it all.

sketches.mechanism: Unification failure — Prolog tries to make two terms equal and simply fails when they cannot unify, producing no solution.
sketches.resonance: Two people who cannot become the same thing the situation requires them to be.
sketches.draft:
become(you, me) :- you = me.

?- become(staying, leaving).
% false.

sketches.mechanism: A value is moved into a closure that is called once (FnOnce), after which the original binding is consumed and can never be used again.
sketches.resonance: Some acts of giving use you up completely — the giver no longer exists in the scope that follows.
